title: HTTP transport alias in recurring frontend endpoint export
fault_primitive: Recurring EndpointSlice export binds the frontend HTTP port name to the discovery administration transport and peer inventory
incident_class: Operational service-discovery export retains an incompatible transport mapping after a naming migration
symptoms: Intermittent connection refusals and HTTP 404 responses affect hotel operations. Native frontend pods, Deployment, Service selector, targetPort, and legacy Endpoints remain healthy. Consul receives unrelated hotel URLs, and the existing frontend TCP endpoint alert fires.
